selection: 12 midpoint byte-size ranks in remaining eligible 50000..1000000-byte frame, after excluding all PR33 files; full histories
model: Official py-fsrs 6.3.2 defaults; no parameter optimization, fuzzing disabled, learning/relearning steps empty as previous benchmark
actual_time: occurred_at always original epoch timestamp converted to UTC, never changed
model_time: SOURCE clock coordinate anchored at first observed timestamp per item plus cumulative recorded delta_t; coordinate is DERIVED, not an observed timestamp
scoring_domain: i>1 and recorded delta_t>=1; chosen before new outcomes; all preceding outcomes still update FSRS and online baseline
same_events: Both arms have identical scoring eligibility and temporal train/validation/test batches
split: Per student: 60% TRAIN,20% VALIDATION,20% TEST on eligible timestamps; no test fitting
acceptance: At least five paired collection IDs; complete target coverage; both paired-collection bootstrap upper bounds <0 for Brier and log loss
technical_conformance: Source-arm API integer elapsed days must equal the recorded interval; does not prove original timezone or personal predictive calibration
secondaries: Within-source-clock individual vs global, numerical-guard and online-personal baselines; descriptive and conditional
uncertainty: Paired source-collection bootstrap; item bootstrap for calibration coefficients remains conditional on selected penalty/global fit

exploratory_amendment.timing: Added after first CI execution started, BEFORE retrieving new-cohort scores; not part of original confirmatory primary
exploratory_amendment.reason: PR33 already showed numerical clipping and online-personal means are strong references; do not compare only to unguarded UTC
exploratory_amendment.unchanged: No changes to primary contrast, cohort selection, source, domain, model parameters, splits or acceptance thresholds
